Social_and_Family_History.content: Runs approximately three times per week.
Experiencing work-related stress for about 2 months with late nights.

Assessment.content: Acute unilateral left-sided headache with differential diagnosis of tension-type headache versus migraine.
Assessment.source_text: 1. Acute unilateral (left-sided) headache — ddx tension-type headache vs migraine

Assessment.content: Migraine considered possible due to unilateral distribution and photophobia.
Tension-type headache considered possible due to work stress and anxiety.
Generalized anxiety disorder with current work stressors contributing; patient is on sertraline.
Assessment.source_text: 2. Generalized anxiety disorder — on sertraline, current stressors from work contributing.

Assessment.content: Sleep disturbance and dehydration considered possible exacerbating factors for symptoms.
Assessment.source_text: 3. Sleep disturbance/dehydration as possible exacerbating factors.

Plan_of_Care.content: Start ibuprofen for headache as first-line treatment for suspected migraine.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Headache: start ibuprofen (patient advised that ibuprofen is first-line for migraine);

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient may continue paracetamol if desired for headache.
Advise to ensure 7–8 hours of sleep per night.
Advise to drink 1.5–2 liters of fluids per day excluding coffee and tea.
Advise rest or lying down as helpful for symptoms.
Consider a short period off work of about one week with self-certification to reduce stress.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Work: consider short period off work (self-certify ~1 week) to reduce stress.

Plan_of_Care.content: Encouraged to pursue counselling; clinician to provide local self-referral link.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: encouraged counselling — clinician to provide local self-referral link.

Plan_of_Care.content: If no improvement at follow-up, consider blood tests and further investigation or imaging.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: If no improvement at follow-up: consider blood tests and further investigation/imaging.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient advised to contact sooner if symptoms worsen or new concerning signs develop.
